content: Wynne will always remember Room 8 with Cato. They still have their blanket from the ship, as faded and plain and stained as it is. They became so close, and went through everything on that sub together. They remember laughing with him and Arctura, and how panicked he would get under the water. There’s not one single memento or moment for Wynne. They made a best friend and brother on this adventure, and that is Cato.

Percival has many fond memories to choose from in regards to Cato whether it be Him mediating the conflict between Note and Castor, Cato reviving Percival by shoving a berry down percy's throat in a kiss, Percival "accidentally" 😉  hitting cato with the javelin of lightning. But the fondest memory Percival has of Cato is all the way back from london when Percival met the white hart. Cato was right there by him the entire time showing care and regard for percival and even chased down the white hart... Percival will never forget Cato.

Lilia has always correlated Cato with sipping tea and peaceful conversations. He has a big heart and always wants to protect people. Out of all her memories with him, her favorite was probably the day he convinced her to join the knights. Because of Cato, Lilia found a sense of purpose in the town. She became a part of this community because of him. Lilia values Catos friendship so greatly because of these reasons. She will always enjoy their quiet conversations drinking tea in the trees.

Navar saw so much of himself in cato, the grief, the anger, and the drive. He appreciated every battle he had next to cato and how much he wished he could spare cato the fate of loss. But he was proud of cato's desire to improve and overcome, he only wished cato had the wisdom to find the peace navar lacked.
Cato has it now 🙂 Navar would be proud. I miss that guy...

Truth be told, Web didn't have a lot of super intense moments with Cato. But they do know that Cato is part of their family. And that means Web would do anything for him. They know that he is a good dad to Wren, a good friend to Wynne and Baeshra, and a fierce protector of what is good and just. They know that Cato has made some truly impossible choices and been through imaginable struggles. To Web, Cato is simply a good man, trying his best. And his best is damn good.

Dear Tanner.
This season has been one hell of a ride. We have been through some intense moments. But I have seen you grow. And even ask for feedback which is a sign of wisdom. I hope that wisdom continues as you grow into a good husband and (If you choose it) perhaps some day a daddy. I care about you, more than I care about Cato (which is saying a lot). I hope these words find you well and when you look back on them, that the story of Roanoke will always be a part of your marriage. Just as your marriages both in game and out are now a part of mine. ❤️ Friend Bfdm

Although Heki has not officially interacted with cato, Gil did a lot.  To me though, our interactions didnt really begin until Gil called you power hungry.  from that moment on, Cato worked tirelessly to earn gil's respect (which Cato absolutely earned).  with that said, the memory Gil would pass on if he could, is the daily ritual we had developed.  Berries dropped off when Gil got up, and Cato searching out his friend when her got up.  Our conversations were always on the official side, but felt warm.  They felt genuine, and in the end, Cato was one of the few people Gil absolutely considered friend.  So with that said, maybe Lilia can find one of the many empty bags that are stained with Sandiberry juice to represent the friendship these two had.

Rockman and Ebuc both saw Cato as a brother. The moments they had always invoked lifting the other up out of dark moments. Rockman will always see Cato as family, someone he will always come running to. (Sry its not more... Rockman has had a short life so far)

Storm has watched Cato really grow as a person over the past few weeks, turning into a truly amazing and heroic knight. He has many fond memories of him and will forever cherish. But what Storm will always be so grateful for and will always be appreciative of, is that Cato is the only person who ever took the time to ever ask about anything from Storm’s past, even if it was just for a fun story that might have been largely exaggerated, it was still extremely meaningful to Storm because it helps him work through that pain, through happy memories. Storm over past couple weeks has come to love Cato and would like to consider himself Cato’s uncle as well.

Skitter has always found Cato to be safe. He knows Cato will die protecting him and also is warm and snuggly. He has given Skitter advice when he needs it. And although Skitter doesnt always agree with Cato, he always understands him. A misfit orphan, just doing their best. You wanting to go find your mom was like "yeah I get that" in Skitters mind. He wholeheartedly understood Cato that night and now sorta trusts him more somehow? Also thanks for saving his life again tonight. Fast friends for life.

Leaf will always remember how Cato looked out for her and made her feel welcome. Even back in London when he was catching pigeons on the rooftop, Leaf recognized that just like her, he wanted to find a family and people to care about. He was also one of the first people to really call her out on her self destructive tendencies (hiding, doubting herself ect), which of course she was able to pay forward. He put her on the path to finding her place on the island with Rockman and the Masons. All because of a good cry sesh up in the treehouse 😌
